description: Says whether a project in Toronto needs a building permit, usually does not, or depends, with the City source for the answer. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/toronto-building-permit-checker?project=deck&h=high&att=yes&exit=no

att.description: deck: Will the deck be attached to the house? | shed: Will it be attached to a house, garage or any other structure?

bt.description: opening: What kind of building is it?

chg.description: opening: Will the work affect the structural support or create a new exit?

exit.description: deck: Will it have a roof, or will it be part of a required exit from the house?

h.description: deck: How high will the finished deck level be above the adjacent finished grade?

ht.description: fence: How tall will it be?

kind.description: opening: What is the work? | plumbing: What is the plumbing work?

lb.description: wall: Is the wall load bearing?

mech.description: basement: Will it include new plumbing or heating work?

plumb.description: kitchen: Will you add or move plumbing, such as relocating a sink, shower, tub, toilet or drain? | shed: Will it have plumbing?

pool.description: fence: Is the fence a swimming pool enclosure?

scope.description: kitchen: Is the work limited to replacing cabinets, counters, finishes and fixtures in the same locations?

size.description: shed: What is the gross floor area?

struct.description: basement: Will it include structural or material alterations, such as adding or removing walls, excavation, underpinning or a new basement entrance? | roofing: Will the work include any structural repair, such as replacing rafters, trusses or framing, or changing the roof shape?

suite.description: basement: Will the work create a second suite or any additional dwelling unit?

walls.description: kitchen: Will you add or remove any walls or change any openings?

where.description: fence: Where will the fence be?
